changes.before: Direct squared-norm overflow rejected finite large regressors as having no observable direction; underflow treated finite small columns as zero.
changes.after: hypot accumulation preserves column scaling. Reject complex inputs and unrepresentable norms/parameters. Four extreme unit combinations recover independently specified coefficients and predictions.

changes.after: Reject unrepresentable differences, squared lengths, projections and distances before geometric results. Normal constructed references unchanged.

Five settings use the same central 321 training and 221 separate validation timestamps. Compare acceleration, measured torque and noise-free torque errors; an additional noiseless-position calculation isolates smoothing bias. No automatic window tuning.

changes.finding: Hiding preset buttons in print media blurred the active button. Earlier print checks focused a numeric input and did not expose it.

Both backends record algorithm and common-helper hashes in addition to model/input hashes and versions. Archive checks compare provenance as well as numeric references.

Keep original training-column norms separate from zero-safe division scales. Explain that fixed-frequency single-axis amplitude scaling preserves column-normalized rank/condition while parameter standard deviations change inversely with amplitude.

changes.finding: Additional 200-percent text plus root letter/word-spacing stress exposed two existing unbreakable inline formulas (OnStove goal and six-variable list), producing 359px page width at a 320px device layout.
changes.implementation: Display the goal predicate in a native scrollable formula and split the variable list into separately wrapping inline formulas. Preserve mathematical meaning and anchors.
Use the geometry point validator for returned witnesses, consistently rejecting huge integers, booleans and nonnumeric coordinates before endpoint/segment checks. Default JSON references unchanged.
Move the five-library comparison and both independent quickstarts to the first reading-guide item. Synchronize existing acceptance entries with column norms and common-time window comparisons.

changes.finding: Default intrinsic column compression made the original small numeric-table headers nearly vertical at 320px.
changes.implementation: Shorten the headers, explain units/counts in adjacent prose and retain compact no-wrap cells with native horizontal scrolling; avoid broad comparison-table widths.

Explicitly scope certificates to the exact disk model. A 1.18m by 0.10m rectangle fits a 1m doorway when aligned, although its 0.60m enclosing disk cannot; enclosing radius checked as 0.5921148537m. Collision-free outer volumes provide conservative collision checks, while outer-volume failure alone does not certify real-shape infeasibility.
70-digit Decimal convex minimization independently checks 195 point/segment and segment/wall-ray distances, plus three strict-contact cases. The source suite now contains 22 tests.
